title: The teacher born in George Washington's time remembers a Native American friend
place_text: Range Two, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: remember the teacher in 1965 who had been born when George Washington was born

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s among tall white beings at a remote US Air Force range in Nevada, describes a being he calls the Teacher. He says that in 1965, at Range Two in Indian Springs Valley, the Teacher, who he says was born around the time George Washington was born, remembered a Native American friend. If true, it would mean these beings live for centuries.
